title: Contrix Agent Protocol Object
description: Schema-registry object for agent protocol metadata snapshots. Event payloads for cx.agent.* MUST use the typed payload definitions in event-payload.schema.json; this object is not a loose transport envelope and is closed at the top level except for x_* extensions.

agent_id.description: Stable agent runtime identifier. v1 uses a DID here; cx:agent:* is not a registered typed-id kind. Agent session object ids use cx:agent_session:* in their own fields.

endpoint_url.description: HTTPS endpoint advertised by cx.agent.endpoint events.

did_document_version.description: Method-specific DID Document version / log entry id observed during endpoint validation, when available.

did_document_digest.description: Canonical hash of the DID Document used for agent endpoint validation.

service_entry_id.description: DID service entry id matched during endpoint validation.

service_entry_digest.description: Canonical digest of the matched DID service entry, bound into protocol_session.start / status / result audit evidence.

session_id.description: Per-invocation correlation id used by protocol_session.start / .status / .result to pair request/response.

status.description: Session status for cx.agent.protocol_session.status events. Same enum as agent_session_status_payload.status in event-payload.schema.json — the registry-object snapshot MUST carry the canonical session state machine, not a coarse subset.

params.description: Caller-supplied parameters for protocol_session.start. Opaque to soland — agent runtimes interpret per agent manifest.

result.description: Terminal payload for cx.agent.protocol_session.result. Free-form; agents document the shape.

detail.description: Runtime-side detail surface (intermediate progress, bridge identifier, error context, etc.).

audit_binding.description: Signed audit binding emitted with the terminal *.result event so callers can prove the agent runtime executed under a specific capability grant.
